profile.description: A neutral developer profile used to prove deterministic GitHub Copilot projection behavior.

roles.name: Reference Builder
roles.description: Use when implementing the fixture reference application from its canonical contract.
roles.responsibility: Implement the bounded reference application and provide testable evidence to the reviewer.

roles.name: Reference Reviewer
roles.description: Use when reviewing the fixture implementation and its evidence against acceptance criteria.
roles.responsibility: Review implementation evidence independently and report concrete blockers without editing code.

capabilities.name: Build Reference
capabilities.description: Build the fixture reference application with deterministic tests and explicit receipts.
procedure: Read the canonical specification and acceptance checks.
Implement the smallest bounded change that satisfies the specification.
Run the focused tests and retain their non-secret result.

capabilities.name: Review Reference
capabilities.description: Review the fixture implementation for contract fidelity, regressions, and missing evidence.
procedure: Read the canonical specification and changed files.
Run the focused validation without modifying the implementation.

handoffs.label: Review implementation
handoffs.prompt: Review the completed implementation and its focused test evidence against the canonical contract.

instructions.description: Use when modifying fixture application or test files generated from the developer profile.
rules: Do not add credentials, deployment commands, or production claims.
Run focused tests after every substantive edit.

prompts.name: Build Reference
prompts.description: Implement a bounded fixture change from the canonical specification and acceptance checks.
prompts.argument_hint: Describe the fixture behavior to implement
prompts.task: Implement the requested fixture behavior from the canonical specification, run focused tests, and report the changed files and evidence.

prompts.name: Review Reference
prompts.description: Review a fixture implementation for contract fidelity, regressions, and evidence gaps.
prompts.task: Review the requested fixture implementation without editing it. Report blocking findings first and identify any missing focused evidence.

steps: Open the generated workspace in VS Code.
Confirm the generated adapter manifest matches the source profile digest.
Select the appropriate generated role or prompt for the task.

profile.session_context: This workspace is a fixture-only GitHub adapter projection. It cannot deploy, promote certification, or write canonical plays.
guardrails: Do not deploy or mutate cloud resources.
Do not claim readiness beyond fixture evidence.
Do not write canonical solution-play content.
